4011108.Name: Mini Toolbox
4011108.Description: Contains various crafting tools, each with a special purpose that allows creators to bring their ideas to life, crafting perfect furniture from scratch.

4011109.Name: Arcane Airbrush
4011109.Description: With pigments sourced from the mystical dreafs of Dreamwood, this tool paints furniture in captivating, dreamlike hues.

4011110.Name: Molten Hammer
4011110.Description: A forging hammer made by dwarven craftsmen. It shapes remarkably sturdy frames, ensuring furniture withstands the test of time.

4011111.Name: Soulbound Quill
4011111.Description: A magical pen that brings visions to life, each stroke sparking new ideas and giving furniture a unique artistic flair.

4011112.Name: Unyielding Stone
4011112.Description: Sourced from dwarven workshops, it smooths furniture surfaces to a silk-like finish, offering a surreal sensation with every touch.
